objective: Verificar exclusivamente, despues del FAIL de pytest de la UAT controlada Gate12N R1, si el cleanup dejo Development sin residuos. No reintentar UAT, no ejecutar mutaciones, no cambiar codigo. Confirmar Socio exacto con PersonaID NULL y ClienteCRMID sin cambios, conteos Gobierno_Persona/Gobierno_PersonaVinculo/socios vinculados en baseline 0/0/0, ausencia de Personas UAT12N y FK trusted.

queries.name: cleanup_candidate_state
queries.sql: SELECT CONVERT(varchar(36),SocioID) AS SocioID,CONVERT(varchar(36),EmpresaID) AS UnidadNegocioID,NumeroSocio,NombreCompleto,Estatus,Activo,PersonaID,ClienteCRMID FROM dbo.CavaSocios_Socios WHERE SocioID=CONVERT(uniqueidentifier,N'62CA4D8A-F4B7-4C66-BE8C-2C13C7445A58') AND EmpresaID=CONVERT(uniqueidentifier,N'19E076FB-C6DE-4EA5-84AB-1CAA9E86082C');

queries.name: cleanup_baseline_counts
queries.sql: SELECT (SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) FROM dbo.Gobierno_Persona) AS total_personas,(SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) FROM dbo.Gobierno_PersonaVinculo) AS total_vinculos,(SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) FROM dbo.CavaSocios_Socios WHERE PersonaID IS NOT NULL) AS socios_vinculados;

queries.name: cleanup_uat12n_residual_personas
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) AS uat12n_personas FROM dbo.Gobierno_Persona WHERE RFC LIKE N'UAT12N%' OR Nombre=N'UAT Gate12N';

queries.name: cleanup_fk_integrity
queries.sql: SELECT fk.name,fk.is_disabled,fk.is_not_trusted FROM sys.foreign_keys fk WHERE fk.parent_object_id=OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.CavaSocios_Socios') AND fk.name=N'FK_CavaSocios_Socios_GobiernoPersona';

constraints: No permission role user menu unit company changes
